data.title: Network of Giving Lifts Off in Seattle and Edmonton
data.description: Seattle and Edmonton are the pioneering cities for the launch of Network of Giving, a unique program that enhances community support. Local merchants have the discretion to decide the extent of their contributions towards regional nonprofits, marking a significant step forward in community collaboration and philanthropy.

data.title: The Salvation Army Mobilizes Disaster Response Ahead of Hurricane Isaias
data.description: Disaster response teams are gearing up to assist communities along the Gulf Coast in the wake of Hurricane Isaias. The Salvation Army's Emergency Disaster Services (EDS) teams in Alexandria, Va., are mobilizing to address the immediate and long-term needs of affected areas. The teams are on standby to offer crucial support as the situation unfolds, emphasizing their readiness to assist in the face of the disaster.
